The ultimate resort of fun! The Ocean Hotel is now back and welcoming guests!

- WHAT TO DO HERE -
🏡 Explore our rooms; suites, offices, boats, treehouses, & more! 
🚀 Observe the map in our space tower!
🍿 Watch movies for free at our cinema!
⛺ Go camping on our small island!
🛝 Ride insanely fun and tall waterslides!
🎒 Attend our in-game school for roleplay!
🚄 Take the train to our mega yacht!
🪩 Visit our nightclub and listen to beats!
And so much more! A resort of fun!
